description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractDDataHandler for managing distributed data collections using Akka cluster data. It handles Bloom filters indexed by ActorRef, providing methods for reading, updating, and subscribing to data changes, with metrics tracking.

classes.name: AbstractDDataHandler
classes.description: An abstract class for handling distributed Bloom filter collections indexed by ActorRef, supporting read, write, remove, and subscription operations with metrics.

methods.name: approximate
methods.description: Abstract method to estimate data related to a topic.

methods.name: getSubscribers
methods.description: Retrieves ActorRefs subscribed to any of the given topics.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads the current distributed data map with specified consistency.

methods.name: removeAddress
methods.description: Removes all subscriptions associated with a specific network address.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds or updates subscriptions for a given ActorRef with specified topics, either replacing all or incrementally.

methods.name: removeSubscriber
methods.description: Removes a specific subscriber from the distributed data.

methods.name: receiveChanges
methods.description: Subscribes an ActorRef to changes in the distributed data.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the Akka data key for the distributed map.

methods.name: getInitialValue
methods.description: Provides the initial empty value for the distributed data map.
